bio: Set in the old Østerbro machine factory on the edge of town, ARO upholds the theme of having skilled craftsmen in its workshop. The room has a modern, industrial feel, courtesy of exposed ducting and industrial lighting, and the stark walls and floors are punctuated by black wooden furnishings and sketches pinned to chipboard panels. The atmosphere, too, is pleasingly laid-back, with both the service team and the chefs looking after the guests. Choose either a three- or seven-course set menu, where the chefs get playful with wonderfully fresh produce to create some interesting dishes with a strong identity....
